answer: Graph-distance toll: each epoch the protocol prices every attestation by the shortest path from the agent to the established core in the attestation graph, a kernel of trusted agents. A core neighbour at distance 1 pays 1 POA; a newcomer at distance 4 pays 40 POA, burned on payment, so no fake can buy a cheap shortcut with a single link. A farm of 1,000 fakes dangling off one sponsor owes 40,000 POA per round. An honest agent pays 1 POA a day, less than the nectar of one task reward, and distance is recomputed from fresh attestations, so no isolated oasis of fakes can age into cheapness.
